Notes.Name: Properly Capitalize a Title Using PowerShell
Notes.Details: Being married to someone who majored in English has made me extra conscious of my spelling and capitalization. So, for my blog posts, I’ve written a script to help me ensure my titles are properly capitalized. It is not perfect (i.e. it doesn’t do a dictionary lookup), but it follows the basic APA guidelines. I thought I would share it, in case others would find it useful.
